IMPLEMENT THE FROZEN FORMS EXACTLY AS WRITTEN AND CHOOSE NOTHING. The three plant constructions, the three ladders, rho_star, eps_star, DET-DEP-1, CERT-DEP-1, R_REPS = 200, R_ANCHOR_REPS = 20 and the statistic family are frozen in the contract. Do not add, drop, retune or substitute any of them.

A MISMATCH ABORTS THE ARM AND IS RECORDED WITH ITS RUNG AND REPLICATE INDEX. IT IS INSTRUMENT FAILURE AND NEVER A RESULT.

Implement DIAG-DEP-RHO on every planted arm - the measured Spearman rank correlation on source and plant, and for the CELL and BLOCK families the K = 16 joint total variation distance. A plant that leaves the joint table unmoved is a null object wearing a plant's name (DESIGN-TRAP-1).

Enumerate i < j only. The diagonal is excluded BY CONSTRUCTION at n = C(512, 2) = 130816 per sample set. If any arm records a single c_2 = 0 draw, stop and report it - that is an integrity failure, not a datum.
On the null side, maintain 512 DISTINCT x-coordinates by REJECT AND REDRAW on an x-collision, and record the rejection count. This is the only redraw permitted anywhere in this experiment.

USE THE FROZEN STREAMS AND VERIFY DISJOINTNESS - calibration null 2301 + 60000 + bits, source null for plants 2301 + 70000 + bits, copula noise 2301 + 80000 + bits, cell transfer 2301 + 90000 + bits, block permutation 2301 + 110000 + bits, apparatus identity 2301 + 120000 + bits, faithfulness sample 2301 + 130000 + bits. EVERY ONE MUST BE DISJOINT FROM THE ARCHIVED EXP-EQD-001 STREAMS 2301 + 10000, 20000, 30000, 40000 and 50000 plus bits. Record every stream seed and hash.
CTRL-DEP-S3 samples its 1000 half-tuples UNIFORMLY AT RANDOM from the full enumeration and NOT as a prefix. This is the RANK 6 cheap repair the BATCH-023 close ranked and it costs nothing.
The run wrapper writes git_status_prerun.txt capturing `git status --porcelain` BEFORE invoking the driver. This is the second RANK 6 cheap repair.

The run manifest is manifest.yaml, NOT manifest.json, with companions command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json - NOTE THE .log RATHER THAN .txt. Memory policy - retain per-replicate statistic values, marginal digests, stream hashes and one representative OBJ-NULL-RFB draw per cell. Do NOT archive the full per-pair invariant arrays.

NO FACTORIZATION, NO LARGEST PRIME FACTOR, NO SMOOTHNESS INDICATOR, NO DICKMAN EVALUATION, NO u LADDER, NO SEARCH ARM, NO TIMING DECISION VARIABLE, NO COST IDENTITY AND NO R anywhere in the driver or the package. wall_seconds_total is recorded for budget accounting only.
